summary: Iteration 10 — Full backend + frontend validation of Stash Go rename, /api/ai/discover conversational discovery, and Turkish terminology cleanup. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_10.py — POST /api/ai/discover empty query → 400; whitespace-only → 400; unauth → 401; IDENTIFY 'a movie where a woman meets a man on a train' returns real TMDB-enriched cards (positive tmdb_id, poster_url, reason, saved=false) with intent in {identify,recommend}; RECOMMEND EN '90 minutes suspenseful but not too dark' returns ≥2 real titles with non-empty message; RECOMMEND TR '90 dakikam var, gerilim ama cok agir olmasin' returns ≥2 real titles that are NOT machine-translated (assertion + observed via UI: Phone Booth, Red Eye, The Shallows, Run, Crawl); results are NOT auto-saved AND not library-scoped (fresh account library stays empty); after POST /api/library {tmdb_id,media_type,title}, re-querying flips saved=true with entry_id equal to the newly-created library entry (or, when the LLM shuffles the result set, the item is verified present in /library). Regression pass: /auth/register+login+me (role=user), /discoveries text auto-save, /library filters (media_type, watch_status) and 4 sort modes (recent/release/rating/alpha), /search returns 200. Frontend (390×844) with fresh account uitest+1788910192@gmail.com: Home shows testID home-ai-entry + 4 chips (home-ai-chip-discover.c1/c3/c4/c5), 'Ask Stash Go', 'Your library'; tapping the entry navigates to ai-discover-screen; typing the train clue into ai-input and pressing ai-send yields 6 ai-result-<tmdbId> cards with per-card ai-save-<tmdbId>; pressing save flips 'Save'→'Saved' and persists on the same card; navigating to Profile→Settings, switching to TR via settings-lang-tr updates the entire tree — Home reads 'Kütüphaneniz', tab bar reads 'Ana Sayfa / Kütüphane / Listeler / Ara / Profil', Library title reads 'Kütüphane', Settings delete-desc + AI screen title contain 'Stash Go', ZERO occurrences of 'Kasa' or 'Vault' across Settings/Home/Library; running the Turkish clue on ai-discover returns REAL untranslated original titles (Phone Booth, Red Eye, The Shallows, Run, Crawl) with reasons in Turkish. One user-facing brand miss: the large 'TRACE' wordmark still renders on the auth screens (login.tsx:65, register.tsx:40, onboarding.tsx:81) — everywhere else the brand reads 'Stash Go'. No red screens, no page errors; only expected pre-auth 401 on /auth/me at boot.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: run `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://media-vault-api.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration_10.py -v -o addopts=''`. rca_of_issue: Only one issue found — a rename oversight. Fix: replace the string in login.tsx:65, register.tsx:40, onboarding.tsx:81 with 'Stash Go' (or expose an i18n key like `brand.wordmark`). No functional impact.
